verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a real-time media relay and CDN, so telephony bridging is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only WebTransport/WebSocket, ffmpeg/OBS/GStreamer ingest, and HLS/CMAF/WebRTC playback. Nothing mentions SIP, PSTN, dial-in or dial-out.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out
